(primarily in europe and asia), $ 1.4 billion of which income taxes have been provided for, and was generally available for repatriation to the u.s. Dollar across all currencies, the potential losses in future earnings, fair value or cash flows are not material. Sensitivity analysis has limitations; for example, a weaker u.s. Dollar would benefit future earnings through favorable translation of non-u.s. Operating results, and lower commodity prices would benefit future earnings through lower cost of sales.
